home.heroText: Khai Minh connects Vietnam manufacturing sites with Taiwanese engineering management, covering surface treatment, precision machining, MEP work and equipment repair.
home.aboutTitle: From equipment sourcing to on-site repair, we make industrial delivery steadier.
